lanes.summary: The diff implements exactly what is requested in PMAT-3711 and the Cop ruling. It introduces `GpuGoldenLeg` and updates the pipeline to classify CUDA initialization and GPU generation errors as gate failures (`FAIL`) instead of skipping. It successfully separates cases into actual errors vs intended skips (no device, no cuda feature, non-GGUF). The runtime gate is also updated to use the measured backend via `InferenceResult::used_gpu`, satisfying the Cop ruling to label the actual dispatch outcome instead of the intent. All required test cases and mutations are covered in the new tests. No gates were weakened; instead, the GPU validation gate has been strengthened.

The diff perfectly implements the requirements of PMAT-3711. It fixes the critical bug where GPU generation errors were incorrectly reported as a SKIP, allowing broken GPUs to pass the gate. Now, `validate_gpu_golden_output` uses `GpuGoldenLeg` to correctly distinguish between `Passed`, `WrongAnswer`, `Errored`, and `NotRun`. Only valid skipped states ("no cuda feature", "no CUDA device on this host", "judges GGUF only") result in a skip. Furthermore, it implements the Cop ruling for `run_golden_output_gate_runtime` by properly asserting that the GPU actually served the request (`used_gpu` signal from dispatch), failing if it silently falls back to CPU. Comprehensive tests have been added to verify these behaviors. No gates are weakened and no unexpected behaviors are introduced.

`run_golden_output_gate_runtime` correctly names the backend that actually ran based on `used_gpu` and fails if it unexpectedly falls back, fulfilling the Cop ruling.
Case rows (tests) added to verify GPU errors, skips, correct generation, and wrong answers.

lanes.summary: PMAT-3711: The diff satisfies all acceptance criteria and the folded cop ruling without refutation. (1) In `output_verification.rs` and `golden_output.rs`, CUDA init and GPU generation errors in the dense golden gate now yield `GpuGoldenLeg::Errored`, which fails the gate naming the error rather than skipping/hiding behind CPU pass. (2) Skips are strictly restricted to cases where the leg never starts (`!cuda_feature`, `!cuda_device`, or dense-loader on non-GGUF/hybrid). (3) In the runtime gate (`run_golden_output_gate_runtime`), the reported backend is measured directly from `InferenceResult::used_gpu`; any fallback to CPU when the GPU was expected fails the gate, and runs without a device are accurately labeled CPU. (4) All 14 unit tests in `golden_output_tests` pass cleanly under both default features and `--features cuda`, and `check_roadmap_completion_is_cited.sh` and `cargo fmt` pass. Verdict: PASS.
